FILED s530c (Opus agent, 2026-10-31).  Newly EXPOSED by #3854's fix (YAML-PP-v0.39.0 t/54.glob.t used to stop in subtest `valid`; it now passes that subtest, 4/4 inner rows, and stops right after it).  Not narrowed yet.

    tools/run-dist-t.pl ~/.cpan/build/YAML-PP-v0.39.0-0 t/54.glob.t
  perl 5.40.3: ok 1 - valid / ok 2 - ioscalar / ok 3 - error / 1..3
  PCL (s530c): ok 1 - valid, then dies: Can't locate object method "descend" via package "main" at - line 1.
`descend` is Test::Deep's comparison method (Test::Deep::Cmp subclasses; `Test::Deep::descend($got, $exp)` calls `$exp->descend($got)` on a Test::Deep object).  The next code after subtest `valid` is subtest `ioscalar`: `IO::File->new("< $Bin/54.glob.t")`, `$yp->dump_string($fh)`, `like $dump, qr{--- !perl/glob:IO::File}` -- no cmp_deeply there, so the die is either a Test::Deep call from the END of subtest `valid` (its loop runs cmp_deeply per object) or a `like` routed into Test::Deep.  "via package main" says the invocant was the STRING "main" (or an unblessed value stringifying so).  The run also prints three #2610 detector lines for Test/Deep/Cache/Simple.pm `weaken` (lines 30, 45, 46) -- a candidate: Test::Deep::Cache::Simple's weaken parsed as a list call.
ROWS: YAML-PP-v0.39.0-0 54.glob.t *PLAN* (re-attributed from #3854 by s530c).


=== QUEUED (s530, Fable, 2026-10-31) ===
One of the 41 REAL whole-file CPAN board failures (the USER-asked review; 138 FAIL files = 69 perl-skips + 4 fixed + 2 perl-fails + 22 ruled not-supported + 41 real).  Queued as s531b member 7 (YAML-PP) -- `briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s530/s531a-prompt.md` / `s531b-prompt.md`.


=== HANDED BACK (s532c) === (Opus agent, 2026-11-08) -- NOT STARTED beyond the re-measure; back to the queue.
Re-measured on main 9c150764 (code ce665621), one-file `tools/run-dist-t.pl --rows --oracle` (s532c scratch m0/): t/54.glob.t 1 ok / 0 not ok then rc 2, no plan (perl 3 rows); t/37.schema-perl.t 3 ok / 0 not ok then rc 2, no plan (perl 105 rows) -- both unchanged from the baseline's *PLAN* rows (Can't locate object method "descend" via package "main", inside Test::Deep).
WHERE TO START: the die SITE -- scratch/s532c/bt2-run.sh (in the s532c worktree) transpiles DIST/TFILE as run-dist-t does and prints a 40-frame backtrace at the die whose message contains MATCH: `bt2-run.sh ~/.cpan/build/YAML-PP-v0.39.0-0 t/54.glob.t descend OUT`.  The question is who calls `->descend` on the string "main": Test::Deep's `descend` is a method on a Test::Deep::Cmp object, so an object expected there is the string/package name -- look at Test::Deep::wrap / the class a `cmp_deeply` argument is blessed into, and at #4061 (a first-bless representation decision) / #4000 (rebless) before assuming a new mechanism.

=== RE-KEYED (s536a) === (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08) -- both rows -> #1611 (its UNDECLARED residue).
The die site (backtrace, scratch/s536a/bt/): Test::Deep::descend -> `$d2->descend($d1)` where $d2 = wrap($exp) is an UNBLESSED hash.  wrap() calls `hash($data)`, and `hash` is a constructor Test::Deep installs at run time by a computed glob write (`*{$name} = $sub` over @constructors); `hash` is in ExprToCL's %RUNTIME_NAMES and not declared, so the call lowered to the runtime's anonymous-hash constructor `(p-hash $data)`.  Not #4061 / #4000 (no bless is involved: the constructor never runs).  Reduction and fix shape in #1611's s536a note; scratch/s536a/p/4104-2.pl reproduces with Test::Deep alone, 4104-3.pl with plain perl.
ROWS: YAML-PP-v0.39.0-0 54.glob.t *PLAN*, 37.schema-perl.t *PLAN* -- keyed #1611 in baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv.

Its two *PLAN* rows now key #1611 (the RUNTIME_NAMES hijack; s536c is on it).
